title: Merge auto-commits every bookkeeping root bee itself writes
action: `bee worktree merge` refuses its own output. Before merging it auto-commits main's bookkeeping dirt, but `main_bookkeeping_roots` (merge.rs:170-176) returns only `.bee` plus `docs/history/<feature>`. bee also writes `docs/decisions/taxonomy.json` on every `decisions log` (verbs/decisions/mod.rs:120-121) and `docs/knowledge/**` on every capture sync. Both are git-tracked, both fall outside the auto-commit scope, so phases.rs:122-136 refuses the merge by naming a path bee wrote itself. This is the deadlock the user reported: main held exactly `.bee/decisions.jsonl` and `docs/decisions/taxonomy.json` and the pending worktree could not land. Widen `main_bookkeeping_roots` to include `docs/decisions` and `docs/knowledge` alongside the two it already returns. Widen ONLY that: the function's callers (the exclusion pathspecs at merge.rs:87-104 and the commit at merge.rs:141-146) need no change, and the commit message built at phases.rs:141-144 should keep naming what it swept. The boundary that must survive intact is that arbitrary source dirt still refuses, named by path — `dirt_outside_bee_still_refuses_and_names_the_offending_path` (tests.rs:1335-1353) pins it with `unrelated.txt` and must keep passing untouched. Add a test in the same module, modelled on `this_features_docs_history_dirt_is_auto_committed_alongside_bee` (tests.rs:1358), that dirties a tracked file under `docs/decisions/` and one under `docs/knowledge/` in main and asserts the merge completes green with `bookkeeping_commit.committed == true`. Note the scope string at phases.rs:125-128 is what a refusal prints; if it still says only `.bee/ or docs/history/<f>/` after the widening it now lies, so update it to name the roots actually swept.

truths: A tracked dirty file under docs/decisions/ in main is auto-committed and the merge completes green
A tracked dirty file under docs/knowledge/ in main is auto-committed and the merge completes green
Dirt at an unrelated source path still refuses with WORKTREE_MERGE_MAIN_DIRTY and names that path
The refusal's scope string names the roots that are actually auto-committed, not a stale shorter list

artifacts.substantive: main_bookkeeping_roots returns the four roots; no other behaviour changed
a new test proving docs/decisions and docs/knowledge dirt is swept, beside the untouched refusal test
